what: Each photo cell (item) scattered over the panel gets a different depth. Scroll: while a cell passes from the bottom to the top of the screen, it shifts in parallax by half of 50~100 (.25× for every third cell), from + to −. Mouse: cells move opposite the mouse position on screen by up to ±50px, each following later by .005~.0125 per step so depths stagger (off on touch devices). Float: the float child travels (7%,−5%)→(5%,7%)→(−8%,4%) over a random 15~35s. Intro: cells visible on screen rise one after another, staggered .2 apart, from one screen height below, at .2× scale and transparent, over 2s with expo.out. Randomness is fixed by a seed, so it is the same every time it opens.

options.spread: Scroll parallax range (random value added to the minimum), default 50
options.dur · each · delay · ease: Initial rise length (2) · stagger (.2) · delay (0) · curve (expo.out)
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Photo slot (position and size set by the consuming css)
options.[data-fx-part=intro]: Layer to raise first (item if none)

from.where: index.html .gl-field (HeroCards — 24 photo cells in the Hero)
